title: THE ALYA x KUZE ANIMATION is FINISHED!!
author: Admin
excerpt: Download THE ALYA x KUZE ANIMATION is FINISHED!!.zip
content:
Hello everyone!!

Thank you all for your incredible patience, a lottttttttttt of love and detail went into this project. The level of detail on the character models this time was deadly... however I think it ended up being worth it in the end! I love these guys and love their dynamic. I hope you guys enjoy it!!!

Here is the LINK to the full animation!

Edit 11/30/25: I have updated the link above to correct a few small errors that were in the original animation.

It was a pleasure doing this animation, and I'm learning a lot about working with other people. I've got a lot of ideas on how to create better systems to better improve production going forward, and I'm super excited to try them out.

I got to meet a lot of cool people on this project as well, which helped in my learning haha

UPCOMING ANIMATIONS:
SONO BISQUE DOLL EP 3
SOLO LEVELING
SAKAMOTO DAYS
KAIJU NO. 8

I'm going to sit down and try to create a proper plan for each project, deadline wise.

My main goal right now is increasing output speed, but also finding ways to give you guys more content while you wait.

I am all ears about what type of things you guys want to see from me!

One idea I had was fully rendering the first few shots of each project and releasing teasers for the "Episodes" that you guys are waiting so patiently for!

Let me know what you guys think!!

Thank you all once again for your continued support, I hope to keep growing and making animations for you all!!

title: End of September Update Post! + Previews
author: Admin
excerpt: Hi everyone, Thank you for all the wonderful reactions to the Kaiju No. 9 video! That ending made me laugh more than a few times while I was working on it.
content: Hi everyone, Thank you for all the wonderful reactions to the Kaiju No. 9 video! That ending made me laugh more than a few times while I was working on it. I think some of the effects in that video might be a Maplestar first! I’m so excited that I was able to release a video in both August and September. I’m always happy when I’m able to do consecutive releases! It’s thanks to the support of every patron that I’ve been able to keep growing this Patreon and taking on more projects. Now, on to the September previews: The first and second previews are for the One Piece project. The third preview is for the short High School DxD sequel. The fourth and fifth previews are for the Frieren project. The sixth preview is for the Bleach project. The next release will be Frieren, and I’m beyond excited to share it. I’ve approached this project with the utmost care to do the story and characters justice. The final linework and coloring are nearing completion, after which it will move on to compositing and final audio. You can expect the release by November at the latest, but I think there’s a good chance it’ll be ready sooner, so stay tuned! Maple-chan, One Piece, the short High School DxD sequel, and Bleach are all moving along nicely. Maple-chan and High School DxD will also be out before the end of the year, with One Piece and Bleach following early next year. I promised more Bleach previews around October, but I decided to share one this month because I’m just so excited about the project! I’ve also noticed some of the comments, and they’re making me think another Bleach project might be in order sometime in the future. I know there are plenty of other characters people would love to see! One last announcement: you can now find me on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube! I’ll be sharing short edits of past projects to help spread the word about this Patreon and hopefully make even more videos for you all in the future! https://www.instagram.com/maplestar_art/ https://www.tiktok.com/@maplestar_art https://www.youtube.com/@maplestar-animation It’s always exciting to finally share projects with everyone after months of working on them behind the scenes. Knowing that all of you wonderful patrons look forward to these animations and take the time to share your thoughts makes the whole process unbelievably fulfilling. Your support gives me the opportunity to put more time and care into these animations, and I never take that for granted. There’s so much I’m looking forward to sharing, and I hope you’ll have a great time watching what’s coming! I hope October brings you all plenty to smile about! 🎃

title: REZE FULL ANIMATION
author: Admin
content: Hello everyone ! The Reze x Denji full length video is finally done!! There was a lot of build up to this one! Here is the LINK to the full animation with english subtitles! ¡Y aquí tienen el ENLACE a la animación completa con subtítulos en español! Having the lead up/foreplay to this one done in the videos prior to it I think worked well for me, I'm curious how everyone feels about it. It helps gauge interest and lets me read into what people are hoping to see before the entire project is done. Usually with single one-off projects, I read afterwards what people see, and go "man, I'd love to do a sequel". A few projects have gotten them! I feel like the best ones are the "series" we do where there are multiple parts. I've been wanting to do sequels more recently. Anyway, thank you for your patience on this project! I feel like this is the most boning we've had in a single video, haha! I am actually open to a sequel with Reze x Denji, I would probably want to do a post-Chainsaw Man manga setting, and give some more emotion/story to the video. For sure more boing, but I think it'd be fun to see where their romance could go. In regards to what comes next, that long awaited poll is still coming! I've got all the entries sorted out, it shall be posted between Reze's release (today) and the next project's release, which will be Sakamoto Days! After that, it will be Kaiju #8. Reminder, those projects are smaller, they are just small short videos. After that, Frieren x Himmel (a full length), and after that, Maple-chan's first video! I believe One Piece will come out after that one. That's the current looks of things! There are some small side projects that may peak up along with these releases, but I'll keep those under wraps for now, I'm sorting out some things on those still. :) Another update soon on everything, love you all, and thank you so much for your support!! This may be obvious, but truly, I would not be able to make these if not for each and every one of you. Thank you so much for believing in me. -Maple
